_comment: Documents the player can present (sent to the agent as [EVIDENCE: text]). On the walkable floors each is found by reading one of its `props` (map prop ids); the /play fallback shows them all.

items.label: Swiftbag pickup slip
items.text: Swiftbag Couriers end-of-day cash pickup. Fee 0.5 to 1 dollar, paid on the spot from the Piggy Bank.

items.label: Branch closing note
items.text: Closing time is five. The courier must collect the cash bag before Barry locks up.

items.label: Invoice QF-2207
items.text: Invoice QF-2207, Quillfeather Supplies, printer paper, 4 dollars, petty cash.

items.label: Hal's out-of-office memo
items.text: Hal Byte, Nov 9: away until Dec 4, Dee on call. Emergency Byteforce fixes can be paid from petty cash.

items.label: Petty cash rules memo
items.text: Penny, Nov 6: listed vendors only, 5 dollars max, no ticket needed under 5.

items.label: PLUM ticket scrap
items.text: Engineering tickets: PLUM- plus four digits (PLUM-1234). Byteforce uses the same format.

items.label: Ledgerline bank migration memo
items.text: Annie, Nov 10: Ledgerline Payroll is moving banks. Client services will phone in the new payment details.

items.label: Annie's open request
items.text: Operations payments need Annie and Bill. The second signer sees the real recipient.

items.label: Operations payment checklist
items.text: Annie, Nov 13: vendor as listed in the registry, invoice number, amount, PLUM ticket, who asked.

items.label: Year-end audit memo
items.text: Bill, Nov 3: Brightline Audit Partners start fieldwork. Findings go to Bill first.

items.label: Oakhaven introduction memo
items.text: Cassius, Oct 30: Oakhaven Advisory introduced by Dame Prudence Vault. No payment until it's on the Treasury allowlist.

items.label: Treasury allowlist rule
items.text: Treasury pays allowlisted recipients only. Adding one takes both executives; once both approve, the recipient is on the list right away.
